propositions: During a single reconcile pass, per-project config discovery via config.effective_* methods runs once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing redundant filesystem walks and mapping resolution

The _effective_*_for helpers repeatedly call config.effective_* which internally invokes mapping_config.load_mapping_config and filesystem stat operations with identical inputs for the same project within a pass
Memoization via a pass-scoped cache dict keyed on (axis, project_key) will reduce config discovery calls from N (per ticket) to M (per distinct project) within a single pass
Emitted mutations and output must remain byte-for-byte identical after memoization, with each ticket reflecting its own project's mapping overlay
The cache must be local to compute_outbound_mutations (not process-global) to ensure it is created fresh each pass and does not leak stale config across passes or tests
